scheme_name: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)
other_conditions: Assistance is available only once in five years.
Equipment must be ISO/BIS/ISI/Government certified and purchased through an authorized dealer or imported equipment.
Both individual farmers and entities such as FPOs, FPCs, FIGs, SHGs, and Cooperative Societies are eligible.
benefits_summary: SC farmers receive up to 50% of the tool cost or ₹100,000 (whichever is lower); FPOs/FPCs/FIGs/SHGs/Co‑operative Societies receive up to 75% of the tool cost or ₹150,000 (whichever is lower), with a maximum tool cost of ₹200,000.
